column1: # Pterohost: egg variable -> PalWorldSettings OptionSettings key.
# Everything the panel is allowed to own lives here rather than in the
# bootstrap, so adding a setting is a line in this file and a variable on the
# egg. Keys absent from this table are never touched: they belong to the owner.
#   str    quoted; a double quote in the value is dropped, since the format has
#          no escape for it and an unbalanced quote breaks the whole tuple
#   float  bare float, normalised to six decimals - Palworld writes 1.000000 and
#          the parsers around it have historically rejected a bare "1"
#   raw    written exactly as given (enums such as None/Casual/Normal/Hard)
# Ports and RCON/REST switches are set by start-palworld itself: they follow the
# panel's allocations rather than a variable the customer can retype.
#   ALLOW_CONNECT_PLATFORM -> CrossplayPlatforms. The egg offers a single
#   platform while the game takes a tuple, so making it live today would cut
#   Xbox players off servers that accept them now. Needs a multi-select on the
